prereg_note: Authored BEFORE capture. This file pins the exact view-spec the demo card will capture against; pipeline.run_pipeline refuses pre-render on any mismatch. The prereg file itself is hash-bound in every receipt and in the lane EVIDENCE.md.
freeze_law_ref: VISUAL-GATE-1 prereg law: thresholds are frozen in the view-spec; the gate never adjusts a threshold to pass an observed frame; any change mints spec_version+1 and a new prereg hash.
exception_law_ref: VISUAL-GATE-1 exception law: a frame passes only via an exception declared in the view-spec; every exception pass emits a machine receipt row with census evidence; prose-only exceptions are refused.
capture_plan_law: One pipeline run per case; the four planted defect classes must be REJECTED and the healthy/declared cases must PASS through this exact template path (prereg -> capture -> two-stage gate -> receipts -> review export).
